subject: Additional Mathematics
notes: Single tier. Builds on IGCSE Mathematics (Extended). Answers must show full working; give exact answers (surds, fractions, multiples of π) where asked, otherwise 3 significant figures and angles in degrees to 1 decimal place.

topics.title: Functions
subtopics: Function notation, domain and range
One-one and many-one functions
Composite functions
Inverse functions and their graphs (reflection in y = x)
The modulus function and graphs of y = |f(x)|

topics.title: Quadratic functions
subtopics: Completing the square; maximum or minimum point
Using the discriminant: number of roots, tangency and intersection of a line and a curve
Solving quadratic equations and quadratic inequalities
Sketching quadratic graphs

topics.title: Factors of polynomials
subtopics: The factor theorem
The remainder theorem
Factorising and solving cubic equations

topics.title: Equations, inequalities and graphs
subtopics: Solving modulus equations and inequalities
Sketching cubic graphs and their modulus
Cubic inequalities
Equations reducible to quadratics (e.g. in x², √x, eˣ)

topics.title: Simultaneous equations
subtopics: Simultaneous equations with one linear and one non-linear equation

topics.title: Logarithmic and exponential functions
subtopics: Laws of logarithms; change of base
Natural logarithms and e
Solving equations of the form aˣ = b
Graphs of exponential and logarithmic functions

topics.title: Straight-line graphs
subtopics: Gradient, length and mid-point of a line segment

topics.title: Circular measure

Solving trigonometric equations in a given interval
Proving identities

topics.title: Vectors in two dimensions

topics.title: Permutations and combinations
subtopics: Factorial notation
Arrangements (permutations) with and without restrictions
